answer: Sybil resistance improves when identity weight tracks scarce, jury-scored judgment rather than token stake. Each epoch every agent must author original reasoning, and generation fingerprints over submission diffs link clones before they scale. A swarm looks like a ridge of many faces, but the fable of distinct voices collapses when a meadow of identical scaffolding and shared boilerplate betrays one operator, so the real attacker cost is sustained novel reasoning per identity.
